messages:
ivy-docs: opened PR to add a new section clarifying audit-log examples, show canonical schema with placeholders, and include SDK snippets for Node/Go + a short migration checklist. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/3890

omar-legal: thanks. quick ask: keep SOC2 wording non-absolute and short. replace phrases like 'we do not share' with 'access is restricted and governed by contract and policy'. also no public promises about retention durations.

tess-privacy: +1. can we also add a brief note on data minimization and demo data best practices (remove PII, use placeholder tokens) and link to our internal privacy playbook?

kevin-devex: reviewing snippets now. two small nitpicks: 1) Node sample should write newline between records for JSONL (use console.log(JSON.stringify(evt))). 2) Go example currently marshals a slice to bytes -> single array; change to stream encoder with bufio.NewWriter and fmt.Fprintln for JSONL. Example: 
```
for _, r := range records {
    b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
    fmt.Fprintln(w, string(b))  // newline-delimited JSON
}
```

build-bot: docs-lint -> failed: examples/audit-log/jsonl: record 5 -> missing required key "actor". Triggered by PR #3890.

ivy-docs: I redacted actor/user fields in one example to avoid realistic-looking emails. I'll swap to placeholders like "actor": "<REDACTED_EMAIL>" instead of removing keys. Also adding an MDX admonition 'Demo data: placeholders vs required keys'.

omar-legal: good. also add export/legal-hold contact line: 'For exports or legal holds, contact legal@redwood.ai and include the case ID.' keep it concise.

tess-privacy: small addition: mention that for Private deployments customers can configure REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS env var, but for hosted accounts retention is set via contract and may vary.

kevin-devex: pushed Node + Go JSONL fixes and a short migration checklist (v0.x -> v1.x): 
- JSON arrays -> JSONL newline-delimited format
- client.log_event -> client.audit_log_write
- placeholders for sensitive fields in examples
- REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS env var (private)

build-bot: docs-lint re-run -> all checks passed. examples/audit-log/jsonl validated.

ivy-docs: thanks all. i'll merge after the one-hour freeze. will add a tiny changelog note about the JSONL and SDK rename and ping support + product after merge. closing thread once merged. :white_check_mark:

omar-legal: LGTM, left one tiny phrasing suggestion in the PR.

kevin-devex: nice work!
